name: db-backup
description: Backup multiple database types on a scheduled basis with many customizable options. Manual Backups can be performed by entering the container and typing backup-now For diffrent port please add variable DB1_PORT and include the port For more DB backups you can include DB2_NAME etc https://nfrastack.com/db-backup/recipes/backup Check advanced for more settings

variables.name: DB01_NAME
variables.description: Schema Name e.g. database or ALL to backup all databases the user has access to.

variables.name: DB01_TYPE
variables.description: Type of DB Server to backup couch influx mysql mssql pgsql mongo redis sqlite3

variables.name: DB01_HOST
variables.description: Server Hostname e.g. mariadb. For sqlite3, full path to DB file e.g. /backup/db.sqlite3

variables.name: DB01_USER
variables.description: username for the database(s) - Can use root for MySQL

variables.name: DB01_PASS
variables.description: (optional if DB doesn't require it) password for the database

variables.name: DEFAULT_SPLIT_DB
variables.description: If using ALL - use this to split each database into its own file as opposed to one singular file

variables.name: DEFAULT_BACKUP_INTERVAL
variables.description: How often to dump DB Minutes Defaults 1440 = Day

variables.name: DEFAULT_BACKUP_BEGIN
variables.description: https://nfrastack.com/db-backup/recipes/scheduler

variables.name: DEFAULT_CLEANUP_TIME
variables.description: Value in minutes to delete old backups. 10080 = One Week. If you want all backup delete this key.

variables.name: DEFAULT_COMPRESSION
variables.description: Use either Gzip GZ, Bzip2 BZ, XZip XZ, ZSTD ZSTD or none NONE

variables.name: DEFAULT_COMPRESSION_LEVEL
variables.description: Numerical value of what level of compression to use, most allow 1 to 9, except for ZSTD which allows for 1 to 19

variables.name: DEFAULT_GZ_RSYNCABLE
variables.description: Use --rsyncable (gzip only) for faster rsync transfers and incremental backup deduplication.

variables.name: DEBUG_MODE
variables.description: DEBUG_MODE

variables.name: DEFAULT_CHECKSUM
variables.description: Either MD5 or SHA1 or NONE

variables.name: DEFAULT_CREATE_LATEST_SYMLINK
variables.description: Create a symbolic link pointing to last backup in this format: latest-(DB_TYPE)_(DB_NAME)_(DB_HOST)

variables.name: DEFAULT_ENABLE_PARALLEL_COMPRESSION
variables.description: Maximum amount of threads to use when compressing - Integer value e.g. 8

variables.name: USER_DBBACKUP
variables.description: The uid that the image should read and write files as

variables.name: GROUP_DBBACKUP
variables.description: The gid that the image should read and write files as

variables.name: DEFAULT_FILESYSTEM_PATH_PERMISSION
variables.description: Permissions to apply to backup directory

variables.name: DEFAULT_FILESYSTEM_PERMISSION
variables.description: Permissions to apply to files.
